description_en: Deletes a resource control rule from a specified PolarDB for MySQL cluster
description_zh: 删除指定 PolarDB MySQL 集群中的资源控制规则
kebab_example: aliyun polardb delete-resource-control --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-cluster-id pc-00000000000000 --resource-control-name test_rc --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteResourceControl

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the PolarDB cluster.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98041.html operation to query available regions
parameters.help_zh:
PolarDB 集群所在地域的 ID。
您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98041.html接口查看可用地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The cluster ID of the PolarDB cluster
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the resource control rule. The name must be 1 to 63 ASCII bytes in length, start with a letter, and can contain letters, digits, and underscores
parameters.help_zh: 资源控制规则名称。长度为 1～63 个 ASCII 字节，必须以英文字母开头，仅支持英文字母、数字和下划线
parameters.name: resource_control_name
